text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing Emma. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
